**Over the past two weeks, colleagues took to London’s canals by canoe to help remove litter from our waterways as part of our Super Group Cares commitment.**


What started as a volunteering activity became something much bigger. It was a chance to come together, act and make a visible difference in the communities where we live and work.


By rolling up our sleeves and getting out on the water, we demonstrated what going All in really means. Not just talking about positive change, but actively contributing to it.


A huge thank you to everyone who volunteered their time, energy and enthusiasm. Every bag of litter collected helped make our waterways cleaner, safer and more enjoyable for everyone who uses them.


Through[Super Group Cares](https://supergroup.com/supergroupcares/) , we’re bringing our global efforts together under one shared purpose: creating meaningful, lasting impact in the communities that matter to us. And this canal clean-up was a fantastic example of that in action.


One team. Shared impact. Together, we’re *All in* .
